directive: Do not weaken any existing headline. Split the repair into two layers. NONRESIDUAL COMPILER/PROGRESS: add def:initial-token-compiler, lem:nonresidual-progress, and lem:published-trace-scheduling. Define the initial and regenerated agenda by the standard recursive ID case splitter: first enumerate every supported-context selector-gate occurrence; after these are discharged, repeatedly choose the canonically least currently applicable operation among (i) remove nonancestors of Y, (ii) split a multi-district graph, and (iii) apply a reachable fixing step; declare a state residual-ready only when none applies. Never preload an ineligible least token. For a successful Lee-Ghassami-Shpitser derivation, compile its finite derivation DAG in dependency-topological order with published stable vertex/context order as tie-breaker. Prove the invariant that after k scheduled steps the emitted labelled kernels equal the first k published kernels after gate reinsertion, every registered denominator is the corresponding supported positive margin, and the remaining agenda is exactly the unexecuted suffix. Consume these lemmas in thm:transition-soundness-termination and thm:published-positive-preservation without citing oeq:all-residual-dichotomy. RESIDUAL LAYER: keep oeq:all-residual-dichotomy open and thm:formula-or-global-twin-completeness dependent on it. First prove thm:ordinary-id-reduction using the Shpitser-Pearl recursive ID construction: compile successful terminal recursion to a projection circuit and failing recursion to its hedge; translate the hedge to two canonical response-function models, mix both with a common strictly positive rational baseline, and choose a sufficiently small rational perturbation preserving exact support H, every supported observed cell, and a nonzero target contrast. Package this as lem:ordinary-id-residual-compiler. For general fixed-support residuals, try the Lee-Ghassami-Shpitser recursive district/fixing construction on the projection side and the Kivva-Mokhtarian-Etesami-Kiyavash general-identifiability witness construction on the negative side, with the same rational interior-mixing lift through fixed kernels and observed descendants. Target these directly at oeq:all-residual-dichotomy; do not mark it resolved until they exclude an identified residual whose only observable functional is algebraic but nonrational. Elimination calculations may diagnose an obstruction but are not accepted frozen residual candidates. Do not re-propose formula/twin/stuck trichotomy, trace existence in place of deterministic return, or a weakened ordinary-ID classification.

This is the bounded noncircular root repair. Do not weaken any existing theorem and do not install a successful published derivation as an agenda. Define exactly one compiler determined solely by the current normalized state and the fixed input order. Its explicit recursion must inspect the current graph/kernels and choose by a fixed case order: enumerate supported selector-gate occurrences actually present; remove nonancestors when the graphical predicate holds; split the current graph when its districts are explicitly computable and multiple; apply the canonically least reachable fixing only after deriving its margin certificate inductively from previously registered positive kernels; otherwise emit an explicit residual state. Eligibility must be a decidable predicate whose certificate is constructed and proved, never a clause saying the compiler attaches the required certificate. Define residual-ready independently as failure of each graphical predicate, not as absence of a compiler-selected token. Prove nonresidual progress by exhaustive finite case analysis on those predicates. Prove published-positive preservation by a simulation relation between this fixed input-determined recursion and Algorithms 1-2: show each fixed recursion step corresponds to a published step and conversely that a successful support-licensed published derivation cannot be diverted into residual under the fixed case priority. Do not place the published derivation in the machine input or agenda. For ordinary ID, add a residual compiler only if you explicitly prove the Shpitser-Pearl formula or hedge is encoded in the frozen candidate lists. For a hedge twin, handle arbitrary finite categorical alphabets, give an induction through observed descendants proving equality of the entire supported observed law and persistence of target contrast, preserve the fixed canonical response expansion and independent-root factorization, exhibit rational-affine dependence of every primitive coordinate on a common positive rational box, and supply the exact candidate encoding, polynomial equalities, and rational coefficient-bound sign certificate expected by the verifier. If those steps are not discharged, keep the ordinary residual lemma and general oeq:all-residual-dichotomy open rather than sketching or weakening them. Do not re-suggest oracle agenda compilation, assumed ledger certificates, formula/twin/stuck replacement, or trace existence in place of deterministic machine return.

Implement the actual recursive ID/LGS task machine; do not weaken any theorem. Represent each unfinished task explicitly as (G,q,Y_task,X_task) plus selector context and ledger. The sole input-determined compiler must apply the published recursive case splitter to this task: remove nonancestors of Y_task; split multiple districts into proper child tasks; in a single-district case compute the district required by the recursion and fix only its prescribed complement, following an explicit valid fixing sequence; never select an arbitrary fixable vertex from Y_task or the queried district. Declare residual-ready only at the corresponding published recursive terminal/failure case, independently of verifier success. Prove the positivity-ledger invariant one fixing step at a time along the prescribed sequence, deriving each new denominator as the required nonempty supported-cell sum divided only by earlier proved-positive ledger entries. Prove published preservation by a simulation between this fixed task recursion and Algorithms 1-2, not by changing the fixed set or installing the successful trace. For termination, replace the scalar/global-token measure with the well-founded multiset extension of per-task ranks (cardinality of the current task mask, refined by within-task phase/token count): show ancestor restriction and prescribed fixing decrease the affected task rank, and district splitting replaces one parent by finitely many strict smaller-district children so the multiset decreases. Only after these proofs land may thm:transition-soundness-termination, thm:published-positive-preservation, and comparator metadata be rewired. Keep oeq:all-residual-dichotomy and any incomplete ordinary residual compiler open. Do not re-suggest oracle agendas, arbitrary least-fixable vertices, fixing-order invariance across different fixed sets, or a token measure that ignores spawned worklist tasks.

directive:
APPROVE THE FOURTH/FINAL SOURCE-LEVEL REDESIGN. Preserve the field headline and its scope. Do not narrow the claim, preload a successful Lee–Ghassami–Shpitser (LGS) trace, or infer an agenda from the existence of an identifying formula. Leave `oeq:all-residual-dichotomy` as the sole genuine open residual. If any transition below cannot be defined from the input and current state alone, identify that exact transition and recommend terminal/cap banking; do not attempt another local repair.

Before defining the machine, state and prove `prop:input-determinacy`: for a finite canonically encoded input I = (G[], H, A, a, Y, p_H), there is a unique initial state `init(I)` and a total deterministic one-step case function `next_I`; fieldwise equal inputs and current states have equal successors/results. Every set, value, district, sequence, and candidate is selected by the fixed topological/lexicographic encoding of I. `next_I` may inspect only I and the current task fields. It may not inspect a published formula, a successful derivation, target extensional equality, an oracle token list, or a theorem asserting that LGS succeeds. Prove determinacy directly from finiteness, decidability of the displayed graphical predicates, and uniqueness of canonical minima; then prove all run prefixes are functions of I by induction.

Replace the single global-mask state `zeta` by
`State(I, Work, Factors, Ledger, Result)`.
`Work` is a finite multiset of explicit tasks:
`Start`;
`District(D*, phase, C?, G_C?, q_C?, contexts?)`;
`Fix(G,q,T,continuation)`;
`A2(D*,C,G_C,q_C,remainingCandidates)`;
`Factor(D*,q_D*,chosenContext)`;
`Join(Y*,pendingDistricts)`;
and `Residual(tag,payload)`.
`Result` is exactly one of `Running`, `Formula(F_H,D_den,D_H)`, `LGSFailPos(D*)`, `LGSFailThicket(D*,C)`, `LGSFailHedge(D*,C)`, `LGSFailA2NoCandidate(D*,C)`, or `ResidualPending(tag,payload)`. The four LGS failure tags record the exact failed line; they are not, by themselves, fixed-support global-twin certificates. Feed them to the residual verifier if a formula-or-twin result is requested. A failure of an invariant that the construction has proved—such as failure to find a fixing sequence for a computed reachable closure—is an internal proof error, not an extra semantic branch.

Define, before the case function, the computable primitives:
`valid(G,π)` recursively checks that each head W satisfies
`dis_G(W) ∩ de_G(W) = {W}` in the successively fixed CADMG.
`fixSeq(G,T)` enumerates all permutations with support exactly T, retains those passing `valid`, and returns the least, or `none`.
`reachable_G(R)` means `fixSeq(G, random(G)\R) ≠ none`.
`closure_G(D)` enumerates reachable supersets C ⊇ D and chooses the inclusion-minimal one, with encoding only as a tie-breaker; prove that it equals the paper’s unique reachable closure and that `fixSeq(G,random(G)\C)` is returned. Never infer reachability from district containment. Fixing-order invariance may be used only after a valid sequence has been computed; it cannot establish existence of that sequence or change the set fixed.
For s ∈ H,
`laidback(s,D)` means every X ∈ D is either not a child of S or has intervention-status component zero;
`seriousSet(s,B) = {X ∈ B ∩ ch(S) : s_X^e=1}`;
and compatibility with `a_spa(D*)` means every selector-forced treatment coordinate occurring in `A ∩ spa(D*)` equals its value in a.
Construct the context-selected graph G[s] mechanically by deleting every labelled edge whose label contains a variable serious under s, erasing remaining labels, and deduplicating edges.
All d-separation, district, ancestor, descendant, nondescendant, strict-parent, support, and compatibility predicates are finite graph computations.

Keep two operations formally distinct:
(1) `TF_≺(q,B)` is truncated/chain-rule factorization: extract the ordered conditional factors `q(X | pre_≺(X))` from q by finite marginalization and conditioning. It changes neither the graph nor the fixed set and has no fixability premise.
(2) `Fix(G,q,π)` applies the CADMG fixing operator only along the already computed valid sequence π. At W it divides by the actual nested-Markov conditional `q(W | nd_G(W), fixed(G))`, not by an assumed generic margin; update the graph by removing arrowheads into W. Do not identify truncated factorization with reachable fixing.

Encode LGS Algorithm 1 line-for-line as follows.

Line 1: `Start` computes the LS-SWIG G[](a,s_empty), sets
`Y* = an_{G[](a,s_empty)}(Y)`, canonically lists the districts of `G[]_{Y*}`, and replaces itself by one `Join` task and one `District(D*)` task per district.

Lines 2–4: for the least pending D*, compute
`L(D*) = {s ∈ H : laidback(s,D*) and s is compatible with a_spa(D*)}`.
If it is empty, return `LGSFailPos(D*)`.

Lines 5–7: compute C = `closure_{G[]}(D*)`. If C=D*, compute
`π = fixSeq(G[], V\D*)`, execute π stepwise on `(p_H,G[])`, choose the least s ∈ L(D*), evaluate the resulting kernel at S=s and at the required coordinates of a, and emit `Factor(D*,q_D*,s)`. The existence of π follows from the computed closure; it is not assumed.

Lines 8–9: if C≠D*, compute
`π_C = fixSeq(G[],V\C)` and execute it stepwise to obtain exactly
`G_tilde = φ_{V\C}(G[])` and `q_tilde = φ_{V\C}(p_H;G[])`.

Lines 10–14: if S∉C, enumerate s ∈ L(D*) in canonical order. For each s compute `G_tilde[s]`, test
`fixSeq(G_tilde[s], C\D*)`.
Choose the least s for which it succeeds, execute that returned sequence, and emit
`q_D* = φ_{C\D*}(q_tilde;G_tilde[s])`.
If none succeeds, return `LGSFailThicket(D*,C)`.

Lines 15–16: if S∈C, create the Algorithm-2 task below.

Encode Algorithm 2 exactly.

Line 1: compute
`ch*(S) = ch_{G_tilde}(S) ∩ (C\D*)`.

Lines 2–3: if `ch*(S)=∅`, return `LGSFailHedge(D*,C)` with the pair `<D*,C>`.

Lines 5–6: otherwise enumerate all supported triples `(sbar,Z,z)` in canonical order, where `sbar∈H`, `sbar` is laidback for D*, `Z=seriousSet(sbar,ch*(S))` is nonempty, z is the vector of forced values carried by sbar on Z, and the triple is compatible with `a_spa(D*)`. For each triple construct the paper’s LS-SWIG `G_tilde[](sbar)`. Compute its districts and accept a D′ only when D*⊆D′; since districts partition vertices, prove that such D′ is unique when it exists rather than supplying it as a “required district.” If none exists, reject this triple and continue.

Line 7: for that computed D′, test exactly
`{D(sbar):D∈D′∩de(S)} ⟂ S |
 {D(sbar):D∈D′∩nd(S)} ∪ spa(D′)`
by d-separation in `G_tilde[](sbar)`, and independently test reachability by computing
`π′ = fixSeq((G_tilde[sbar](sbar))_{D′},D′\D*)`.
Both tests must pass.

Line 8: from q_C=q_tilde, use `TF_≺`, not fixing, to construct the hybrid kernel
`q_D′^{sbar,z}` whose factors for D∈D′∩de(S) are
`q_C(D | S=sbar,pre_≺(D))` evaluated at Z=z,
and whose factors for D∈D′∩nd(S) are
`q_C(D | pre_≺(D))` evaluated at Z=z,
where `pre_≺(D)` is computed in `D′∪spa(D′)` using the fixed input topological order. Multiply the two canonically ordered products. Then execute the computed π′ and emit
`q_D* = φ_{D′\D*}(q_D′^{sbar,z};(G_tilde[sbar](sbar))_{D′})`.
Choose the first passing triple; do not use a published choice.

Line 9: if every enumerated triple fails, return
`LGSFailA2NoCandidate(D*,C)`. This is the paper’s unclassified failure and must become a residual task, not an asserted nonidentification certificate.

Algorithm 1 lines 17–18: when every district factor has returned, `Join` emits
`Σ_{Y*\Y} ∏_{D*} q_D*`,
evaluating each factor at `a` on `A∩spa_G(D*)` and at that factor’s stored laidback context. If any district returned a failure tag, propagate the least tagged failure/residual instead. Never create or infer a context outside H.

Replace the current denominator registry by a step-indexed certificate ledger. An entry contains the denominator circuit, origin, earlier-entry dependencies, an exact cross-multiplied identity, its nonempty branch-reachable cell set, and a positivity derivation. Base entries are
`p_H(S=s)=Σ_v p_H(v,s)` for selected s∈H.
For every conditioning used by `TF_≺`, record its marginal denominator as a nonempty sum of positive reachable cells of the current kernel. For every fixing step, first construct the actual fixing conditional from current-kernel marginals, record every division it introduces, and then record the cross-multiplication proving the successor kernel. After substitution into p_H and cancellation, record an exact factorization into a positive rational constant, earlier ledger entries, and nonempty sums of branch-reachable positive kernel cells. Induct on ledger order: admissible-cell positivity proves the base; earlier positivity and nonempty positive sums prove each new entry. Do not assume a denominator is supported merely because a published branch used it, and do not retain the old blanket formula `m_{s,W}=Σ_{x_W}K` unless that equality is separately verified for the exact kernel representation.

Replace `muH` by the Dershowitz–Manna multiset extension of a task rank. One adequate explicit rank is the lexicographic tuple
`(|random ambient vertices|, control level, remaining fix vertices, remaining candidates)`,
with control levels strictly descending through
`Start > District tests > closure fixing > post-closure case > A2 scan > hybrid fixing > Factor > Join`.
Within a fixing task the random-vertex count or remaining-fix count decreases; within A2 scanning the remaining-candidate count decreases. `Start` and every district split replace one task by finitely many tasks each of strictly smaller rank (proper district children have smaller ambient masks; equal-mask administrative children have lower control level). Completion removes a task. Prove the rank order well founded, then its finite-multiset extension well founded. A scalar/global token-count argument is insufficient.

Rewire the frozen core as follows. Replace `zeta`’s global `(R,F,Σ,F,L,R)` agenda by the work-multiset state above. Retire free `sigmaTok`, `fixTok`, and `elimTok` agendas: selector handling becomes the deterministic context-graph constructor, fixing tokens become steps of a computed `fixSeq`, and elimination splits into explicit `TF_≺`, ancestor marginalization, district spawning, and `Join`. Replace `resTok` by `Residual(tag,payload)`. Replace `priorityH` by canonical least-work-task and least-candidate selection. Replace `muH` by the multiset measure. Strengthen `posLedgerH` as above. Rewrite `def:selector-transition`, `def:fixing-transition`, `def:elimination-transition`, `def:residual-transition`, `def:sa-csid-handle`, and `def:sa-csid-machine` around this case function; residual verification remains a verifier of supplied/generated candidates, not an oracle guaranteeing one passes.

Proof order is mandatory. First prove the finite graph-computation, closure, computed-valid-sequence, and `prop:input-determinacy` lemmas. Then prove local selector/context, truncated-factorization, fixing, hybrid-kernel, assembly, and ledger soundness. Only then close `thm:transition-soundness-termination` using the multiset measure and no-stuck progress for every nonresidual control state. Close `thm:published-positive-preservation` by showing the deterministic case predicates are a refinement of each Algorithms 1–2 existential branch: finite enumeration finds a witness whenever the displayed predicate has one. Do not replay or cite a successful derivation as machine data. Equality with a published output is only an extensional conclusion on `O_H(Theta_H)`, obtained from the line-by-line case equivalence and soundness; it is never a scheduler premise.

Replace the hand-installed trace clause in `def:worked-execution`/`prop:worked-execution-certificate` by reduction of `next_I(init(I))` on the displayed graph. Its genuine trace is ancestor restriction to Y, the district D*={Y}, closure C containing S and A, the Algorithm-2 enumeration, failure of the line-7 CI/reachability conjunction for all candidates, and `LGSFailA2NoCandidate`, after which the existing rational contrast verifier accepts `d=(-4,-1,0,3)`. Preserve the already checked common observed cells, exact H, strict positivity, and targets 1/2 and 63/128; do not force irrelevant W0/Z0 selector/fixing/elimination tokens merely to exercise old transition names.

Prove `thm:ordinary-id-reduction` by specializing the case function: with H={s_empty}, all gates laid back and S separated, context construction is the ordinary ADMG; computed closure/fixing is ordinary ID; C=D* gives the ordinary reachable factor; C≠D* enters the S∉C branch and its failed reachability is the ordinary hedge/thicket endpoint. This is a structural specialization proof, not residual-list inclusion by assumption.

After these changes, `thm:published-positive-preservation`, `thm:transition-soundness-termination`, the corrected `prop:worked-execution-certificate`, and `thm:ordinary-id-reduction` should close. Preserve `thm:formula-or-global-twin-completeness` at field tier, but leave its converse dependent only on `oeq:all-residual-dichotomy`; do not mark it proved and do not replace it by a formula/twin/stuck headline. The exact-support lifting of all failure/residual states to either a rational identifying circuit or a global-twin box remains the one genuine open question.

There is presently no input-determined step that is impossible: closure, D′, contexts, CI, reachability, valid sequences, and hybrid factors all admit the finite constructions above. The unresolved issue is only residual candidate exhaustiveness. If implementation again needs a successful formula/trace to choose a context, district, fixing set/order, or hybrid branch, name that first offending case and recommend terminal/cap banking immediately.
